prng.name: lcg32
prng.algorithm: state = seed; next() { state = (Math.imul(state, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return state / 2 ** 32; }
prng.drawOrder: One generator seeded once. Initial heading: one draw times 360. Then for each of the 61 waypoints, in order: x, y, heading delta. Position draws are discarded for portal-edge waypoints, so the draw count does not depend on the portal rule. The 30 s tape reuses the first 31 waypoints of the same sequence.
